description_en: Modifies the configuration of an instance
name: ModifyDBInstanceConfig

parameters.help_en: The name of the configuration item
parameters.name: config_name

parameters.help_en: The value of the configuration item
parameters.name: config_value

parameters.help_en: Ensures the idempotence of the request and prevents duplicate submissions. The value is generated by the client and must be unique across different requests. The value can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length and must not contain non-ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过 64 个 ASCII 字符，且该参数值中不能包含非 ASCII 字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run on the request. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run without calling the API operation. The system checks the request parameters, request format, business limits, and inventory. If the check fails, the system returns the corresponding error. If the check succeeds, the system returns the error code DryRunOperation.
false (default): sends the normal request and directly performs the operation after the check succeeds
parameters.help_zh:
是否对本次请求执行预检查，取值：
true：执行预检查，不真正调用该接口。检查项包含请求参数、请求格式、业务限制和库存等。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误；如果检查通过，则返回错误码 DryRunOperation。
false（默认）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接执行本次操作
parameters.name: dry_run
